Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.local-ipc.server
role Serve bounded framed JSON requests over the local endpoint with explicit connection backpressure and method dispatch.
owns local IPC listener lifecycle, IPC frame boundary, local method dispatch
excludes method business logic, remote network exposure
invariant Connections beyond the configured concurrency bound are closed instead of queued without limit. Malformed or oversized frames terminate the connection after one bounded error response.
